content: There exists another straightforward method, Erasure BIBREF7, BIBREF22, BIBREF25, which directly evaluates the word importance by measuring the translation performance degradation of each word. Specifically, it erases (i.e., Mask) one word from the input sentence each time and uses the BLEU score changes to denote the word importance (after normalization).
